newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - AMD up, Motorola mixed.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - AMD up, Motorola mixed.

text.p: Motorola Inc stock eased following an after-hours climb last night, while Advanced Micro Devices Inc rose preceding Tuesday's market open, traders said.
Both companies reported better-than-expected earnings after Monday's market close.
Motorola fell 5/8 from 61-1/8 reached in after-hours trade, though the shares remained above Monday's last NYSE price of 60-1/4, traders said.
Meanwhile, AMD climbed to 43-7/8, above last night's NYSE close of Monday of 41-1/4 and better than the 43 reached in subsequent third market action, traders said.
Motorola posted first quarter earnings of $0.53 a share versus $0.63 and above the First Call consensus estimate of $0.45 a share.
Motorola said the $0.53 a share included gains on the sale of an investment and a favorable patent settlement, but those gains totaled less than 10 percent of pre-tax profits.
Excluding the gains, Motorola earned at least $0.48 a share, analysts estimated.
AMD announced first quarter earnings of $0.09 per share versus $0.18 one year ago.
Elsewhere, Viking Office Products Inc tumbled to 15 from 20 after the company forecasted results for the third fiscal quarter ended March 31, traders said.
